name: EPIC 247530911
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 10.5 solar radii and 1.13 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,334 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.13 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,870 K at its surface.
